status: acceptance specification; no production driver exists in issue 6

notation.time: at and range endpoints are integer seconds after 2026-10-02T09:00:00Z; range is half-open. Default clock epoch boot-1 has equal elapsed/awake deltas matching at. Explicit clock_sample overrides it. For rollback cases wall_utc_seconds overrides the UTC anchor while at remains the chronological dispatch offset; this explicitly separates wall reversal from elapsed time.
notation.identifiers: A/B/P and default/computer-a are aliases. A test driver substitutes stable UUIDs/actor keys per case; all actors initially share computer-a/account 1/user 2/project 3/task 4/UTC and a live default binding unless overridden.
notation.event: op event calls activity.ingest with the given actor/generation/sequence/kind. event_id is stable case-ID plus first event index; replay reuses identity and input, never at as payload. First work resolves default binding. All source input is trusted normalized evidence unless a bridge case says otherwise.
notation.health: source_lost and clock_sample are injected durable source/clock observation transactions, not fabricated host lifecycle callbacks. They persist uncertainty before the next read. Status remains read-only; a new discontinuity noticed only by status may be displayed as stale provisionally, but the next event/observation transaction must persist quarantine before finalization.
notation.recovery: actor+generation selects that case's sole earlier uncertain segment; if_revision current resolves the actual current record revision, old is a previously read superseded revision. Every mutation has a stable per-step request UUID.
notation.expected: confirmed_segments include closed confirmed prefixes; open work is provisional. finalized_union excludes ranges blocked by open/uncertain reservations, including touching endpoints. Arrays omitted in expected mean no assertion; empty arrays explicitly assert empty.
